newsitem.title: USA: Safeway to buy rest of Vons.
newsitem.headline: Safeway to buy rest of Vons.

text.p: Safeway Inc. said Monday that The Vons Companies, Inc. accepted its revised offer for the rest of the southern California supermarket operator in a deal that will create the continent's second-largest supermarket company.
Safeway already owns about 35 percent of Vons' stock and the two companies share directors.
Safeway said it will issue 1.425 shares of Safeway common stock for each share of Vons that it does not already own, up from the 1.34 shares it offered on Oct. 30.

However, based on Safeway's closing stock price Friday of $38.375, the deal values each Vons share at $54.68, or a total of $1.56 billion, down from about $58 a share, or $1.58 billion, under its previous offer. In addition, Safeway will assume about $550 million in Vons debt.
Safeway's stock fell 87.5 cents Monday, trading at $37.50, and Von's gained $2.75 to trade at $51.50, both on the New York Stock Exchange.

The Pleasonton, Calif.-based company said it also agreed to purchase 15 million shares of Safeway common stock from partnerships controlled by affiliates of Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. The price per share would be determined later, it said, but would not be less than $38.375 per share.

The partnerships controlled by the affiliates of KKR currently own approximately 49 percent of the outstanding shares of Safeway common stock and will own approximately 38 percent of Safeway's outstanding shares following the merger with Vons.

"Following discussions with Vons and after receiving updated information regarding Vons performance and its prospects, we agreed to increase the exchange ratio to 1.425 shares of Safeway stock for each share of Vons stock not currently owned by Safeway," said Steve Burd, president and CEO of Safeway Inc.

"The repurchase of Safeway common stock will make the transaction with Vons more attractive than our earlier proposal for both the shareholders of Safeway and Vons," he added in a statement accompanying the announcement.

Vons, one of the largest supermarket operators in southern California, operates 325 stores under the names Vons and Pavilions. Safeway Inc. is one of the world's largest food retailers, operating 1,052 stores in the United States and Canada.
After the merger, the Vons and Pavilions stores will continue to operate under those names.
